description: Duplicate an artboard with the artwork on it (Artboards panel menu > Duplicate Artboards), copy it into another open document, or cut it (move it and its artwork, removing the original). Artwork belongs to an artboard when its centre lies on it

artboardIndex.description: Artboard index (0-based). Positions are measured from this artboard's top-left corner. Default 0

cut.description: Remove the original artboard and its artwork afterwards. Default false

name.description: Name of the copy. Default the original's name

toDocument.description: Name of another open document to copy into (list_documents). Default this document

withArtwork.description: Copy the artwork on the artboard too. Default true

x.description: Left of the copy, from the destination's artboard 0 top-left, in points. Default: right of its rightmost artboard, 20 pt apart

y.description: Top of the copy, measured the same way. Default level with the original (artboard 0 in another document)

name: copy_artboard
title: Copy Artboard
